name: Tessera TKS-12 Enforcer 'Compliance'
description:
The Tessera TKS-12 Enforcer is a semi-automatic shotgun chambered in 12 gauge with biometric authentication, an integrated less-lethal selector system, and real-time telemetry that reports every discharge to Tessera's security management network. The weapon features a dual-tube magazine system — one tube loaded with lethal ammunition, one with less-lethal bean-bag or rubber-slug rounds — and a selector switch that determines which tube feeds the action.

The Compliance embodies Tessera's approach to force escalation: controlled, documented, and selectable. An operator can switch from less-lethal to lethal with a thumb movement, and the telemetry system logs which ammunition type was chambered for every trigger pull. This creates an automatic use-of-force record that Tessera's legal department uses to demonstrate proportional response in post-incident reviews.

The dual-tube system adds bulk and weight, making the TKS-12 noticeably heavier than conventional combat shotguns. Tessera considers this an acceptable trade for the tactical flexibility of having both lethal and less-lethal capability in a single weapon. In practice, the Compliance has reduced the number of lethal-force incidents in Tessera-controlled facilities by providing operators with a less-lethal option that doesn't require switching weapons.
specifications: caliber: 12 gauge effective_range: 35 meters (lethal), 20 meters (less-lethal) rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic magazine_capacity: 4+4 rounds (dual tube) weight: 4.2 kg
tactical_use: A force-escalation shotgun providing instant switching between lethal and less-lethal ammunition. The dual-tube system maintains loaded capability with both ammunition types simultaneously. The biometric lock and telemetry system provide accountability and prevent unauthorized use. Best deployed in scenarios requiring graduated force response — crowd control that might escalate, facility defense with mixed threat levels.
cultural_context: The Compliance is the most hated weapon in Tessera's arsenal among the populations it's used against. The less-lethal rounds are painful, the lethal rounds are final, and the operator's ability to switch between them with a thumb movement feels arbitrary to the person on the receiving end. The weapon's telemetry-driven accountability means nothing to someone being shot with a bean bag.
story_hooks: A Compliance's telemetry records show that an operator switched to lethal during an incident where the threat assessment didn't warrant it — but the telemetry also shows the selector was moved by the weapon's biometric system, not the operator's hand.
A hack of Tessera's telemetry network allows someone to remotely switch every deployed Compliance from less-lethal to lethal simultaneously during a crowd control operation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A purposefully blocky semi-automatic shotgun with a distinctly corporate aesthetic. The dual-tube magazine system creates a noticeably wider receiver than conventional shotguns, giving it a squared-off, almost architectural silhouette. The overall impression is of controlled brutality — engineered restraint rather than raw firepower.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 102 cm | Barrel length: 51 cm | Magazine width: 8.5 cm (dual-tube profile) | Height with safety selector: 7 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty and deliberate — 4.2 kg distributed across the dual-tube system creates noticeable front-heavy balance. Feels substantial in trained hands but burdensome to untrained operators, which is intentional corporate design philosophy.
physical_description.primary_material: Polymer-reinforced steel receiver with integrated aluminum heat-dissipation shroud around dual magazine tubes. Barrel is chrome-lined steel with thermal management vents.
physical_description.finish: Matte anthracite polymer body with brushed stainless steel accents. Weathered in field use but designed to remain clinically clean. Heat vents show burnished aluminum beneath.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: Gunmetal gray polymer | Accents: Clinical white lettering and stainless steel tube housings | Selector switch: Dual-color (red for lethal, blue for less-lethal) with recessed positioning
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized polymer grip with fine diagonal checkering — textured for sweaty or wet-gloved hands. Selector lever is smooth brushed metal with tactile detents.
distinctive_features: Dual-tube magazine housings with labeled port windows (red lethal / blue less-lethal)
Biometric scanner integrated into trigger guard — thin LED strip that glows amber when scanning
Telemetry module mounted on left side of receiver: flat rectangle with small status light
Stamped selector switch with ergonomic paddle design, ambidextrous positioning
Heat vents running length of handguard in three parallel lines
Minimal sighting system: fiber-optic front post, integrated rail for optics
Serial plate on receiver: Tessera corporate logo (stylized lotus), batch code, authorization tier stamp
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Tessera Wellness Clinics logo (lotus symbol) embossed on left side of receiver in small relief. 'TKS-12 ENFORCER | COMPLIANCE' stamped below in blocky sans-serif. Biometric module marked 'Asante Protocol 2226-Rev3' in white lettering. Serial number and authorization tier etched on receiver bottom.
physical_description.condition_typical: Operational field condition: polymer scuffed from equipment contact, heat vents showing dust accumulation, telemetry module lens occasionally hazed with condensation. Well-maintained by security contractors who understand that corporate accountability extends to weapon condition. Rarely truly battle-worn; more often showing the wear of routine facility defense and training exercises.
